This small plot of 0.06 hectares is where I grow my yams and cassava together, as we have always done here in the South East. I do not have money to buy chemical fertilizer or those improved seeds from the agro-dealers, and our local varieties grow well enough in this soil with the rains we get. I will do the mounding, planting, weeding, and harvesting with help from my family, because this plot is too small to waste money hiring outside labor.
